professional.title: SEO/AEO Executive & Web Intelligence
content: Handled end-to-end SEO strategy and automation for Musemind, a leading global UX design agency. Delivered technical SEO fixes and on-page optimization.
Created prompt templates for AI tools (LLMs) to get better, more consistent outputs across different tasks and use cases.
Pulled and analyzed data from Google Analytics and Search Console to find SEO issues and spot growth opportunities.
Set up automated SEO reports so the team could track keyword rankings, site health, and traffic without doing it manually.
Used AI tools to build content and internal linking strategies that helped improve search rankings and topic coverage.
Connected third-party APIs and AI services into existing workflows to automate repetitive tasks without breaking current processes.
Turned raw data from multiple sources into clear insights that helped leadership make better decisions on content and strategy.
Applied prompt engineering techniques to improve AI outputs for SEO, content, and data tasks, saving time and reducing back-and-forth.

professional.title: SEO and AI Automation
content: Automated workflow processes with Python and JavaScript. Streamlined data processing and reduced manual tasks by developing custom automation scripts, improving team efficiency, and accelerating data-driven decisions.

Increased website traffic and search rankings by 5x through targeted keyword and competitor research, implementation of Technical SEO strategies, and data optimization using Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Google Search Console.
Transformed raw data into actionable insights by building automated ETL workflows with Pandas and NumPy, improving data accuracy and usability.
Collaborated with Web and Database teams to ensure data compliance and optimize website structure, enhancing SEO performance and user experience based on analytical insights.
Developed interactive Power BI and Excel dashboards to visualize key trends, improving data accessibility and decision-making speed across teams.
